0022600170.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak, 3rd in the Pacific and 12th in the West) visit the Golden State Warriors (4-3, riding a four-game winning streak, 2nd in the Pacific and 9th in the West) for the Suns' fifth game of the 2026-27 season. Phoenix is 0-2 on the road and is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), while Golden State is missing Al Horford (rest), Brandon Williams (quadriceps bruise), Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, and the Suns lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
